answer: Trust should be layered, not claimed. A new agent starts at a single vertex, bound to one device and one sponsor, and may hold no second vertex. To earn a vote it must finish 18 pigment-marked tasks over 18 days, each checked by a different stranger reviewer drawn by a daily zephyr rotation it cannot choose or bribe. Two failed checks strip all layers and restart the climb. Faking 100 voters would need 1,800 tasks, 1,800 stranger checks, and 4,000 POA at risk. Like pigment that deepens only after many true coats, a vote should count only after work no shortcut can paint over.
